title: CoCAS (Co-Curricular Affairs Secretary)
summary: Shaastra, CFI, E-Cell, Nirmaan and TechSoc.

posts.md:
The **Co-Curricular Affairs Secretary (CoCAS)** represents the interests of IIT Madras' technical, innovation, and entrepreneurship communities.

CoCAS oversees five major student-led organizations that promote technical learning, innovation, product development, entrepreneurship, and national-level competitions.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the Co-Curricular Affairs Secretary.

## Contents

Shaastra

Centre for Innovation (CFI)

Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell)

Nirmaan

Institute Technical Society (TechSoc)

## Shaastra

Shaastra is IIT Madras' annual student-run technical festival and the world's first ISO-certified student-managed technical festival.

Every year, Shaastra hosts hundreds of technical competitions, workshops, lectures, exhibitions, and innovation showcases. It also organizes **Shaastra Juniors**, a technical festival for school students.

## Centre for Innovation (CFI)

CFI is IIT Madras' student-run innovation laboratory where students design, build, and prototype engineering projects.

Students gain access to advanced equipment, workshops, mentoring, and collaborative project spaces.

## Centre for Innovation (CFI)

## CFI Clubs

CFI hosts several technical clubs covering diverse fields such as:

- AI Club

- Aero Club

- Robotics (iBot)

- Electronics Club

- Programming Club

- Product Design Club

- 3D Printing Club

- Biotechnology Club

- Mathematics Club

- Blockchain & WebOps

- Astronomy & Physics (Horizon)

- Accessibility Technology (Sahaay)

These clubs conduct workshops, beginner sessions, and technical projects throughout the year.

## Competition Teams

CFI also supports internationally competitive engineering teams, including:

Raftar (Formula Student)

Agnirath (Solar Car)

Abhyuday (Rocketry)

Anveshak (Mars Rover)

Avishkar Hyperloop

Abhiyaan (Autonomous Ground Vehicle)

iGEM (Synthetic Biology)
CFI also has dedicated teams for:

- Project Management

- Finance

- Branding & Engagement

- Sponsorship & Industrial Relations

## Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell)

E-Cell promotes entrepreneurship and startup culture through workshops, competitions, networking events, and its flagship **E-Summit**.

## Major Activities

- Startup workshops

- Business competitions

- Founder talks

- Startup networking

- Corporate partnerships

- InternFair

- E-Insider Magazine

- Product showcases

- Marketing & PR

- Web & Mobile platforms

## Nirmaan

Nirmaan is IIT Madras' student pre-incubation centre that helps aspiring founders transform ideas into startups.

### Support Provided

Seed funding

Dedicated workspace

Startup mentorship

Investor networking

Product development support

Startup branding

Nirmaan serves as the first step for students interested in launching startups before entering formal incubation.

## Institute Technical Society (TechSoc)

TechSoc coordinates year-round technical activities and represents IIT Madras at the **Inter-IIT Tech Meet**.

## Major Activities

Inter-Hostel Technical Competitions (IHC)

BuildSchool product development program

Collaboration with CFI Clubs

Technical blogs & content

Design & branding

Sponsorship & publicity

Inter-IIT Tech Meet coordination

**Did you know?**

Whether you're interested in **building robots, racing Formula cars, launching startups, developing AI projects, participating in hackathons, or representing IIT Madras at the Inter-IIT Tech Meet**, the organizations under CoCAS offer opportunities for every student to innovate, collaborate, and grow beyond the classroom.
